acceptance.property_registry: The canonical property registry exposes 68 typed fields with explicit IDs, groups, labels, model keys, commands, viewport behavior, and the declared constraints used by the shared Inspector controls. The registry-default contract and preset/value tests keep defaults tied to the actual resolver/validator rather than invented field defaults.
acceptance.node_capabilities: The capability contract covers all 79 declared node types: 45 are PARTIAL and 34 remain PLANNED. PLANNED types are explicitly not certified as editable and are not presented as complete Inspector features.
acceptance.inspector_route_matrix: The real Chromium PARTIAL-type matrix renders every applicable current Inspector property for all 45 PARTIAL types including root and checks its actual registry ID, command, and Page Model key. It verifies that no empty or misleading group is rendered and that field help disclosures are correctly labelled.
acceptance.layout_context: Flex/grid container and item properties are tested against actual parent layout context; inapplicable controls do not appear as empty groups.
acceptance.value_and_history: The current property control families have value normalization/allowed-value, default/preset, reset/inheritance, and Undo/Redo regressions. Responsive design families have dedicated Chromium lifecycle suites for size, spacing, layout, position, typography, background, border, radius, visual effects, and state fields.
acceptance.save_public_and_server: Current implemented property families retain draft Save versus explicit Publish, persisted model values, rendered Canvas/public parity, and the existing server publish-validation contract. The new visibility regression confirms the actual mobile and desktop public renderer across hide/show Save and Publish transitions.
acceptance.scope_boundary: This is the foundation execution point only. Future PLANNED type capabilities remain ordered under 77.44.7.F/77.44.8, and the complete user-facing desktop/mobile/physical acceptance remains deferred to that full Editor gate. Overall feature acceptance remains NOT_CERTIFIED.
